description: This file defines a controller class 'Translation' for managing language translation tasks in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods to generate translation tasks, write translation JSON files, and clear existing translation files, involving interactions with models, language files, and filesystem operations.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class for handling translation-related tasks such as generating, writing, and clearing translation JSON files in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of translation tasks for various store locales and languages, queues them for processing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Creates or updates a JSON translation file for a specific route, store, and language, based on retrieved translation data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated translation JSON files from the filesystem for all stores and configured languages.
